title: Attachment
description: Real attachment entity for mAIvn Platform v2 messages. Source bytes are either a storage reference or bounded inline base64; raw secrets are not fields in this contract.

attachment_id.description: Stable attachment identifier within the owning message or resource record.

filename.description: Sanitized display filename for the attachment.

mime_type.description: IANA media type used for provider content-block routing.

size_bytes.description: Attachment payload size in bytes before base64 encoding.

inline_base64.description: Bounded base64 payload for small inline attachments. Large or reusable resources use storage_ref.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the attachment bytes.

resource_id.description: Optional back-reference to the registered resource row that owns this attachment.

bucket.description: Object-storage bucket containing the attachment bytes.

path.description: Object-storage path for the attachment bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest pinned on the storage object reference.
